sections.title: Pharmacology of Anesthesia and Accessory Drugs I
sections.description: This course explores the various routes of anesthetic administration addressing the potential benefits and risk of each. Special emphasis is placed on specific anesthetic agents and their appropriate use. The responses and common complications associated with these agents are discussed.
